# Configure version upgrades

HCP Vault Dedicated lets you manage the upgrade window for your clusters. For
**Essentials** and **Standard** tiers, you can:

- Set your cluster to upgrade both major and minor version releases
  automatically. 
- Configure a specific upgrade window for major version
  upgrades.
- Manually update your cluster for both major and minor versions. 

When a specific Vault Enterprise version approaches its end-of-life on HCP,
existing HCP Vault Dedicated users receive a notification to upgrade to a
supported version.

For standard-tier clusters with [performance
replication](/vault/cloud/perf-replication), or [disaster recovery
replication](/vault/cloud/cross-region-disaster-recovery), the secondary clusters
follow the upgrade settings of their primary cluster. Secondary clusters do not
display the **Upgrade settings** menu.

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="Major version upgrades">

1. Log into the [HCP Portal](https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com/).

1. From the **Vault clusters** page, click the Vault cluster you want to
   manage upgrade settings for.

1. Click **Upgrade settings** in the left navigation menu.

1. Click **Edit settings**.

1. Under **Select major version upgrade schedule**, select either **Automatic**,
   **Manual**, or **Scheduled**.

   - **Automatic:** Applies the latest validated version.

   - **Scheduled:** Sets a specific day and time window for HCP to apply
     available upgrades.

   - **Manual:** Lets you upgrade your cluster within the upgrade grace period
     (90 days). If you have not upgraded by the end of the grace period, the
     cluster is automatically upgraded. When an upgrade is available, you
     receive an email and a notification in the HCP Portal.

1. Click **Apply changes**.

</Tab>
<Tab heading="Minor version upgrades">

1. Log into the [HCP Portal](https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com/).

1. From the **Vault clusters** page, click the Vault cluster you want to
   manage upgrade settings for.

1. Click **Upgrade settings** in the left navigation menu.

1. Click **Edit settings**.

1. Under **Select minor version upgrade schedule**, select either **Automatic** or **Manual**.

   - **Automatic:** Applies the latest validated version.

   - **Manual:** Lets you upgrade your cluster within the upgrade grace period
     (30 days). If you have not upgraded by the end of the grace period, the
     cluster is automatically upgraded. When an upgrade is available, you
     receive an email and a notification in the HCP Portal.

1. Click **Apply changes**.

</Tab>
</Tabs>

## Terraform

You can manage your HCP Vault Dedicated cluster upgrade settings
programmatically with the HCP Terraform provider. Refer to the Terraform
Registry documentation:

- [HCP Vault cluster resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/hcp/latest/docs/resources/vault_cluster)
- [HCP HVN resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/hcp/latest/docs/resources/hvn)
